title: Single Microphone Own Voice Detection based on Simulated Transfer Functions for Hearing Aids
abstract: arXiv:2603.02724v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents a simulation-based approach to own voice detection (OVD) in hearing aids using a single microphone. While OVD can significantly improve user comfort and speech intelligibility, enabling reliable OVD with a single microphone is desirable for simplifying hardware and reducing power consumption in compact hearing devices. However, most existing solutions rely on multiple microphones or additional sensors, increasing device complexity and cost. To enable ML-based OVD without requiring costly transfer-function measurements, we propose a data augmentation strategy based on simulated acoustic transfer functions (ATFs) that expose the model to a wide range of spatial propagation conditions. A transformer-based classifier is trained using analytically generated ATFs and further fine-tuned using numerically simulated ATFs with increasing geometric realism. translated_title: 基于仿真传递函数的助听器单麦克风自声检测
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的方法，使用单个麦克风实现助听器中的自声检测。虽然自声检测可以显著提高用户舒适度和语音可懂度，但在紧凑型助听设备中，使用单个麦克风实现可靠的自声检测有助于简化硬件并降低功耗。然而，大多数现有解决方案依赖于多个麦克风或附加传感器，增加了设备的复杂性和成本。为了在不进行昂贵传递函数测量的情况下实现基于机器学习的自声检测，我们提出了一种基于仿真声学传递函数（ATF）的数据增强策略，使模型接触到广泛的空间传播条件。基于Transformer的分类器使用解析生成的ATF进行训练，并进一步使用具有越来越高的几何真实感的数值仿真ATF进行微调。这种分层适应策略使模型能够不断细化其学习……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于仿真声学传递函数的数据增强与分层训练策略（先解析ATF预训练、再用数值仿真ATF微调），使基于Transformer的单麦克风自声检测器无需昂贵的真实传递函数测量即可实现可靠检测，从而简化助听器硬件并降低功耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data augmentation strategy based on simulated acoustic transfer functions with hierarchical training (analytical ATF pre-training followed by numerically simulated ATF fine-tuning), enabling a Transformer-based classifier to achieve reliable single-microphone own voice detection in hearing aids without costly transfer-function measurements.
